# Dora

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c10 P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair child with long, sleek hazel curls that never get out of order. She has gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and a prim "prunes and prisms" mouth.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)_

## Personality

Dora is timid, quiet, polite, and exceptionally well-behaved, behaving like a little lady at the table. In contrast to her twin brother Davy, she is submissive and prim, though she dislikes associating with ill-behaved peers.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c10 P14](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0014)_

## Traits

- Timid  <sub>[v2 c10 P14](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0014)</sub>
- Prim  <sub>[v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002)</sub>
- Fear of the dark  <sub>[v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003)</sub>
- Fear of ghosts and dead relations  <sub>[v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007)</sub>

## History

Dora and her twin brother Davy are brought to Green Gables by Marilla Cuthbert after the death of their mother. Unlike her mischievous brother, Dora behaves with quiet propriety upon arrival. She starts attending Avonlea School, where she is temporarily seated with Mirabel Cotton and gets thoroughly frightened by Mirabel's stories about her family's deceased relatives and ghosts. On one occasion, Davy takes her to Mr. Harrison's place to see his parrot, locks her inside a toolhouse on an upturned nail keg, and lies to Marilla and Anne that she is lost, leaving her terrified and cold until Anne rescues her. As she grows up under the care of Marilla and Anne, she continues her studies and helps around Green Gables.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c10 P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 c10 P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 c21 P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008)_
